mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_thread ( thread_id, user_id, title, status, trace_id, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{threadId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{status}, #{traceId}, #{createdAt, typeHandler=com.agentcrossing.platform.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler}, #{updatedAt, typeHandler=com.agentcrossing.platform.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id = VALUES(user_id), title = VALUES(title), status = VALUES(status), trace_id = VALUES(trace_id), created_at = VALUES(created_at), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM chat_thread WHERE thread_id = #{threadId} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT * FROM chat_thread ORDER BY updated_at DESC, thread_id ASC
